steps.action: Determine the kind of quantity the leaf is.

verdict_basis: Not-refuted, not positively-derived. This leaf is engine coverage/presentation metadata, outside the authority of the two permitted oracle sources: 'disposition' and 'view_tag' appear nowhere in the wiki cache or in docs/math-foundations.md, no cached collection has cardinality 178, and the documented formula families all emit numbers. The change therefore contradicts no wiki fact and no quoted formula, while nothing in the sources requires the leaf to stay absent; the cache's own practice-corpus precedent shows disposition-style verdicts are legitimate pinned expectations. I record new_value_correct because no defect is demonstrable, NOT because the 178 entries were independently reproduced.
caveats: The entry count (178) could not be reproduced from any cached population; the nearest cached counts are 176 (SR items carrying effects) and 173 (champions). If the map is intended to range over one of those populations, the off-by-2/off-by-5 gap is worth an in-repo check by a reviewer with source access.
Per-entry disposition and view_tag strings were not verified individually; the oracle sources contain no ground truth for them.
This verdict cannot be read as certification that the dispositions map is semantically right — only that no permitted source falsifies it.
